_readme: A narrative = an itinerary through the items. Each narrative has an 'order' array of ids (from items.json) that defines prev/next.
The same item can appear in more than one narrative, even in a different order.
'timeline' is the required historical narrative. Unlike the first draft of this file, this order is now built from the real
dates in data/items.csv (Claudia's research), not an arbitrary placeholder -- but several dates are approximate ('ca.') and
five items share the same year (1954), so the order within that cluster is a reasonable guess, not confirmed fact.
The second narrative is now named: a thematic one, 'Renzi: Many Lives', split into three parallel threads
(critic / curator / soldier-partisan) sharing the narrativeGroup tag below. Claudia is assigning which items
go in which thread when the team meets (Wednesday) -- the three entries exist so the site can already offer
the choice in a narrative selector, but 'order' stays empty until she fills it in.

narratives.title: Historical timeline
_todo: Based on real dates in items.csv: 1942-07-24 (letter) -> ca. 1952 (Po screenplay) -> 1953-02-01 (L'armata s'agapò) -> 1954 (six items: guida_documentary, la_strada_film, drawing_gelsomina_lastrada, photo_la_strada_fighter, photo_la_strada_woman, photo_lastrada_premiere, la_strada_soundtrack_original) -> 1959 (ferrari_set_photo) -> ca. 1960s (caricature) -> 1969 (book) -> 2000 (interview).
renzi_portrait has no date in items.csv -- placed last as unplaced, needs a real date or at least an approximate period from Claudia/Anna Fiaccarini.

The order within the 1954 cluster (6 items) is a best guess (documentary -> film -> character drawing -> production stills -> premiere -> soundtrack), not verified against real event dates within that year.
